admission_rule: All actual hashes, exact private formatted source inventory and independent artifact review must be supplied and verified before list/models requests are materialized. Nulls are never accepted as a pass. tested_revision remains null; base9098 is ancestry only.
alias_check: Root rlib alias and hashed rlib byte-identical; authenticate all three files and exact matching ordinary profile before docs. Bind actual docs artifact selection afterward; no cold 1MiB docs-build claim.
cargo_stream: Require final build-finished success=true, no compiler diagnostics, exact known record kinds; inventory every record/artifact/dependency rather than selecting an executable by basename only. Record actual fresh flags.
clang_requirement: With unchanged absent CLANG environment, bind the actual PATH-selected clang and its observed tool/runtime/link inputs before and after Cargo; preserve actual fixture/build-script reused/fresh provenance, never backfill identity for a reused historical artifact.
dependency_checks: Bind each compiler artifact to exact Cargo.lock package/version/checksum/features and manifest owner
Archive all rlib/rmeta/executable/build-script outputs, aliases, available depfiles and selected registry source/archives used by actual records before shared target changes
Parse complete depfile rules and any env-dep entries without weakening old predicates; require exact owned source paths and frozen source bytes

Root rapid-profiler library source closure: lib.rs, interval.rs, pmu.rs, generation.rs, frontend.rs; test closure additionally generation/tests.rs, generation/owned_tests.rs, frontend/tests.rs; additionally require frontend_tls.rs in the ordinary closure and frontend_tls/tests.rs in the test closure. All old source-owner checks remain.
Preserve build.rs and fixtures/simple.c; account for their build-script compiler/output/depfile and fixture even though focused library tests do not execute that fixture
Read ELF interpreter/needed/rpath and actual selected runtime tool bindings; report selected closure honestly, no inferred complete runtime provenance
docs_prerequisite: Immediately before docs, rehash actual root alias/hashed rlib/rmeta and bound depfiles/source/flags. If missing/different, stop; no warming compile hidden inside the 1MiB test request, no cap increase.
normal_profile: Exactly the test profile with test=false

prior_contract.scope: Historical predecessor contract; full acceptance predicates retained here.

test_artifact: Require one exact library test executable, canonical owned target/debug/deps/rapid_profiler-<hex>, filename record contains the same path; archive whole bytes and authenticate copy before any further target write.
